answer.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and activation is down 6% QoQ. The durable memory shows that shortening onboarding (memory_86) improved completion rates and time-to-value, and signup simplification (memory_31) produced durable lift in first-week activation for SMB accounts. Both memories directly address our current deterioration metrics. Verifying these two will confirm the magnitude and durability of those effects before committing resources. Activation messaging (memory_91) also showed positive results but onboarding completion decline is the more direct lever. Promotional pricing is explicitly flagged as non-durable (memory_73: -12pp retention hit despite +31% signups). Referral incentives work well for established customers (memory_57) but don't address activation/onboarding headwinds. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) targets a different persona and doesn't solve SMB activation decay. A standard onboarding simplification experiment addresses the core QoQ deterioration metrics while avoiding the retention risks of aggressive pricing, and can be executed within one week.
